name: The absolute object (mafʿūl muṭlaq)
definition: The maṣdar in naṣb after its own verb, to confirm it, or to tell its kind or how often it was done.
body: Al-Ājurrūmiyya teaches it under 'the maṣdar': the manṣūb noun that comes third in the conjugation of the verb (ḍaraba yaḍribu ḍarban). It is 'verbal' when its letters are the verb's (qataltuhu qatlan) and 'of meaning' when only its sense is (jalastu quʿūdan, I sat a sitting).
It is not an object of the act but the act itself named again: hence 'absolute', not tied by a preposition.

examples.text: I killed him outright: a 'verbal' absolute object.
